title: Human abduction squads made to look like aliens

tellings.quote: And it wasn't until I started having people come forward who said, "Oh, we piloted these." And then I had guys come forward who had actually been on the abduction squads made to look like aliens.
I was debriefing people who were the ones operating the abduction program that was human.
tellings.difference: Adds that the program's cases were fed to Jacobs, Hopkins and Mack, and gives no decade.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Greer debriefing people who ran a human abduction program meant to look alien.

as_told.title: Human-run abduction program fed to abduction researchers

plain: A UFO activist named Steven Greer says people came to him who had flown man-made craft, and others who had served on human abduction squads dressed up to look like aliens. He says he debriefed the very people running this human abduction program, and adds that its cases were fed to the well-known abduction researchers David Jacobs, Budd Hopkins and John Mack. If true, it would mean some reported alien abductions were staged by people, not by visitors from elsewhere.
